brief:
The user enjoys teen movies for their light-hearted mix of comedy, romantic comedy, and the best parts of being young. They frequently rewatch teen movies they love.

10 Things I Hate About You is one of their favorites. They praise its acting, writing, and casting across the board. They find the storyline interesting and feel its Shakespeare basis gives it more substance than a typical teen movie. They also enjoy its focus on romantic relationships, plentiful comedy, and good flow.

They did not like Superbad very much and felt let down by its hype as a great teen film. They acknowledge some funny lines but say most had already appeared in commercials. They found it overly juvenile, simplistic, and generally not that funny, with a portrayal resembling adults’ assumptions about what teens do. They have never rewatched it and have no plans to.

They have heard of High School Musical and love singing and dancing. They expect those elements would probably entertain them, but did not confirm having watched the film or give an overall opinion of it.
